layout: 8.8 x 2.10 inches; four square panels; one vertical right legend

training.protocol: W&B train/task_success_rate and train/task_invalid_rate over all completed training trajectories collected at each iteration, before dynamic-sampling filtering (15 browser turns). training_success_valid = success / (1 - invalid rate): success among valid trajectories, which removes infrastructure incidents (e.g. Gate B iterations 21-24 and 76-77, 42-90% invalid).
training.smoothing: Trailing 5 recorded iterations, arithmetic mean of per-iteration valid-only success rates; not pooled counts.

validation.protocol: Local browser · GPT-4.1 / action_history · actor temperature 0
validation.metric: 100 * successes / valid episodes at each evaluated checkpoint; invalid episodes excluded

display.smoothing_population: Only evaluations in the displayed 20–90 interval; no pre-20 warmup

smoothing.method: Trailing ratio of pooled success and valid counts
smoothing.missing: Never imputed; no extrapolation before first or after last recorded evaluation
smoothing.interpretation: A descriptive trend, not another evaluation or a confidence interval

validation.raw_overlay: Faint raw checkpoint dots; connected circles show the trailing three-evaluation pooled ratio.

caveats: Historical validation curves use mixed dates. Overall rates use all 300 tasks per checkpoint; valid-only rates use method-specific valid subsets.
Training trajectories are collected by each policy; valid-only collection success is not fixed-task held-out accuracy.
Failures in main batch and 40M+16F are excluded from the compact curves and retained in the results table and all-run archive.

training_axis_note: Reward is the binary outcome reward displayed as a valid-only percentage; ADM bonus excluded.
repetition_definition: 100 * valid episodes with >= k identical non-wait/non-done calls / valid episodes; successes included; occurrences need not be consecutive

repetition_uncertainty.method: Pointwise percentile bootstrap of 300 task clusters, preserving all three repeats, methods and thresholds; ratio recomputed in each resample
repetition_uncertainty.scope: Conditional on fixed checkpoints and three evaluation windows; excludes training-seed and evaluation-window uncertainty; not simultaneous intervals

success_uncertainty.method: Marginal pointwise percentile intervals from shared task-cluster resamples, retaining all repeats and methods; valid-only ratios recomputed in each resample
success_uncertainty.scope: Conditional on fixed checkpoints and evaluation windows; excludes training-seed and evaluation-window uncertainty; horizontal/vertical intervals are not a joint 95% confidence region
